observations.overall_scene: The mask inserts a different central winter scene: a much smaller/simpler blue cabin, thinner trees, a horizontal icy pond and new fence/bridge. The source outside is a more dramatically lit blue/gold painterly forest around a large brown cabin. The generated area has paler/flatter gray light and visibly different scene scale.
observations.top_join_all_paddings: At pad0/32/64 the pale generated sky ends in an obvious broad horizontal transition against the dark source forest. Branches stop or change scale at the join. All three native top strips show the inserted rectangle; padding does not establish a clean transition.
observations.side_and_bottom_joins: New thin tree trunks and branches do not continue the source trees at the left boundary. The pond/water crosses the foreground fence and source snow/stream with visible cuts or blended double structure along the lower boundary. Numeric preservation outside painted mask is not a semantic join guarantee.
observations.padding_comparison: Padding0/32/64 changes generated cabin placement, tree layout and water/fence geometry. Every case remains visibly patched; this single source does not establish a preferred padding.
observations.large_source_detail: The2896 crop still has the inserted-scene appearance. The native cabin crop shows visibly enlarged, soft/simplified generated snow/roof/window detail as the1184x912 working result is pasted into the larger region. The CPU-upscaled source is itself not native high-resolution ground truth.
observations.comparison_limit: No full-canvas ZTurbo render exists here, so there is no direct quality or speed comparison against full-canvas inpainting. This review makes no inference about that missing baseline.
